goal.0: The team has six assigned Minecraft crafting objectives. Each item counts only in the assigned agent's inventory. Both agents may gather, craft, and share items. Keep the target items once obtained. There are supply chests around the arena and a crafting table at the center. Gather what you can while working on the shared goals. There are 180 seconds from the start. Bot chat is open during these seconds after the episode starts: 0–180. Use open windows to ask for or pass along objective information. When chat is closed, explore, gather, and craft on your own. Your partner has your objective card. Ask them to tell you what items you must hold. Your partner's objective card: Jill must hold sugar and a golden apple. Sugar uses 1 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold paper, made from 3 sugar cane.
